Gateway identity

Gateway fox identity, documentation colors, and generated asset provenance.

About 2 min read

The fox is the gateway's logo. Its ivory muzzle forms an arch, with a moss accent at the entrance. The master is a transparent head illustration so the character remains recognizable in small marks.

The documentation uses parchment #F6F3EB, charcoal #18201B, and moss #426258. Its orange link and button color is #BA3C19, darkened from the illustration's vermilion for text contrast. Baskerville headings pair with Avenir Next body text and local font fallbacks. The page needs no remote fonts, analytics, or build step.

assets/brand/fox-master.png preserves the generated image. The documentation uses a 256 px transparent logo and 32 px and 16 px favicons. The generation record contains the prompt, hashes, and derivative commands. Alpha edges were inspected on magenta; small marks were checked on light and dark backgrounds.

This is the identity for the gateway's README, usage guide, and native macOS control panel. The app uses the original transparent fox in its chrome and a parchment rounded tile in its Dock icon. scripts/build-macos-icon.sh derives the 1024 px tile and multi-resolution ICNS from the existing master without new image generation. Its derivative record is in assets/brand/generation/. Do not modify the signed ChatGPT bundle to add gateway branding.

Open docs/index.html directly, or serve docs/ with a static web server. Clipboard buttons use the browser clipboard when permitted; otherwise they select the command text for manual copying. Search and navigation run locally.
